meta.name: hellenic_abyss
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern Hellenist coastal metropolis under sea monster assault

programs.brief: A colossal multi-tentacled sea leviathan rearing out of the ocean surf, smashing into the seawall with dripping dark-prismarine scales, glowing sea-lantern dorsal spines, and massive grasping coils.
A vicious amphibious sea beast with finned spines, claws, and gaping maw clambering out of the surf onto the beachhead.

tokens.terrain: a grand classical-revival coastal city fronting a wide harbour and deep open sea
tokens.event_direction: colossal sea monsters emerging from the open ocean breaching the harbour walls and advancing onto the waterfront
tokens.infra: barricade_line across the waterfront boulevard; emergency_cordon ringing the lower docks; broken quayside piers where beasts have come ashore
tokens.icons: neoclassical monumental colonnades facing the sea; breached seawalls; emergency sirens and modern searchlights illuminating towering aquatic monsters

root.label: the modern Hellenist metropolis under assault from the deep
